goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that start sending a request but never finish it within -rpcservertimeout
Prevent trickle-byte slowloris attacks from exhausting connection slots and blocking legitimate RPC users
agreement: Strong support because it mitigates slowloris DoS vectors and spurious vulnerability reports (pinheadmz)
Verified by simulating slow and fast requests with socat and wireshark on macos/arm64 (pinheadmz)
Open suggestion to assert disconnect reasons via DebugLogHelper in unit tests (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes an unauthenticated slowloris DoS vector that exhausts HTTP connection slots
P2 because trickling clients can indefinitely occupy connection pools and block legitimate callers
